_comment: run_19e = run_19 with K's link switched softplus -> exp: K = k_level * exp(H_k + trend).

At the model's operating point the softplus argument is ~-2.1, where softplus ~ exp, so LOW K costs the same under both links; the difference is the upper tail, which softplus shrinks (softplus/exp 0.74 at 16 route counts, 0.28 at 73) and exp does not -- this tests 'very high K is genuinely possible'.

K's amplitude prior is left numerically unchanged: because softplus ~ exp there, its current calibration is already effectively in log-K units. alpha_k's location is re-solved for the exp link (log of the 2.6183-route-count target), so the level median is preserved.
